verdict.rationale: The pricing page states compute is billed by the second (about $0.000004167/GiB-second) with no one-hour minimum, and paused sandboxes incur storage charges only. The sandbox docs confirm paused sandboxes incur no compute charges, and a soft TTL lets idle sandboxes pause automatically, so users pay only for active compute. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actual per-second billing behavior.
